chunks.excerpt: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of first payment when the product does not meet their needs.
Plan changes take effect at the next billing period.
Enterprise customers with an SLA miss may request a service-credit refund within 90 days.
Enterprise agreements require finance approval before issuing account credits.
Approved refunds are processed through Stripe back to the original payment method within five business days.
Support should confirm the customer account ID before changing billing state.
If the payment processor rejects the refund, escalate to finance and do not promise manual reimbursement until finance approves.
Chargebacks are handled by finance with evidence from support transcripts.
Support should tell customers that taxes are reversed only when the underlying refund is processed.
Month-end ledger close happens on the third business day.
